features.sentence: The researchers took out protein crystals containing nutrients from the gut of the unborn young.

features.sentence: When you come across the phrase “packed with nutrition,” try asking, “Compared with what?” and “For whom?”

features.correct_structure_ja: 主節は「try asking」という命令文で、引用内の問いは比較対象や対象者を尋ねる断片的な疑問表現。

features.sentence: Rather than seeing this as a possible breakfast for people, see it as a way to deliver nutrients to young that have not yet been born.
